## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Security Lab was run; failures/skips are explained.
- [ ] Mobile layout was checked.

## Privacy and security review

- [ ] No account, ads, analytics, hidden telemetry, or payload interception was added.
- [ ] New outbound domains are documented and included in telemetry-audit expectations.
- [ ] New stored fields have retention, export, and deletion behavior.
- [ ] New permissions are least-privilege, user-triggered, and explained.
- [ ] `PRIVACY.md` and the project guide are updated if data flow changed.
- [ ] No real logs, tokens, signing files, or personal data are included.

## Data-flow changes

List new data stored, transmitted, exported, or classified. Write `none` if unchanged.

## Screenshots

Include sanitized desktop and mobile screenshots for UI changes.
